div.div: Three rules a CNI plugin must satisfy: (1) every pod gets its own IP address; (2) all pods can communicate with all other pods without NAT, whichever node they are on; (3) all nodes can communicate with all pods (and vice versa) without NAT, and the IP a pod sees itself as is the IP others see it as. Routed: the route table says which node owns the pod block, packets keep pod IPs. Overlay: pod packets travel inside a node-to-node tunnel.
